Adobe Firefly Workflow

More about me

I'm a senior at Asbury University finishing a degree in instructional design, and I've been doing the job for real since my junior year. My current project is a multi-module Bitcoin course built for a nonprofit serving U.S. military veterans. I own every phase: audience analysis, learning objectives, content architecture, build, and publish.

I taught myself to work at the speed of a small team by building a custom AI research workflow, using Claude to pressure-test my drafts against source material, not to write for me. Every decision still goes through me. AI just makes the quality checks faster.

My toolkit: Articulate Rise 360 for the build, LearnWorlds for delivery, Adobe Firefly for original imagery, and Canva for supporting graphics.
